Cumberland County

Median Household Income$61,000
Median Home Value$200,000
Cumberland County is anchored by Fayetteville in the Sandhills of south-central North Carolina, dominated by Fort Liberty, the Army's most populous installation, on its northern edge. Military rotation keeps rental and resale demand steady, while noise contours and accident-potential zones around the post and Pope Army Airfield restrict development close in, pushing new subdivisions toward Hope Mills and Spring Lake.
Source: U.S. Census Bureau · Data verified: September 7, 2026
